source.statement: Let G_F=U diag(lambda) U^T and M=V diag(nu) V^T be positive-semidefinite with both spectra in descending order. Over every orthogonal D by D transformation W, alpha(W)=tr(G_F W M W^T) is maximized by U V^T and minimized by U J V^T, where J reverses coordinate order.

assumptions: G_F and the data second moment M are real symmetric positive semidefinite
U and V are orthogonal eigenvector matrices
lambda and nu are in descending order
W ranges over the complete real orthogonal group

acceptance.symbolic_exchange_certificate: SymPy factors every two-assignment exchange into (a-b)(x-y), establishing the rearrangement ordering
acceptance.doubly_stochastic_certificate: the verifier checks symbolically and numerically that P_ij=R_ij^2 has row and column sums one for orthogonal R
acceptance.complete_finite_domains: all permutations are exhaustively checked for every dimension 2 through 9 on fixed strictly ordered spectra
acceptance.independent_assignment_checker: a separately implemented linear-assignment optimizer recovers the identity maximum and reverse minimum across fixed random PSD cases
acceptance.orthogonal_sweep: predeclared Haar-orthogonal matrices remain between the certified extrema
acceptance.negative_control: the deliberately wrong identity-is-a-minimizer rule is rejected on strict spectra
acceptance.exit_behavior: verifier exits nonzero if any required acceptance item fails
